{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Filter to loyal customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
df_filtered = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (~qa_mask)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_filtered['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')"}
